items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Well, I met Parker ... I know that ... the first time I met Parker was on 52nd Street. ... So we played with Parker in '48.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Can you talk about that involvement with Granz? What was that (inaudible)?

Well, (inaudible) we got hold of Chico O'Farrill. And Chico wrote the first Afro-Cuban Suite for Machito Band and to feature Charlie (inaudible) and also these single numbers (inaudible) just being released. It was a (inaudible) recording for Mercury (inaudible) released.
